'''Mona Gale''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Information broker/Legends|Information broker]], operating in the [[Old World]] of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3631 BBY]] she was approached at [[Market Station]] by a renegade member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]] [[Senya Tirall]], who was looking for information about the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]]. Unwilling to compromise her business with the Lady, Gale only told Senya and [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] that the Lady occasionally met with the [[Heralds of Zildrog]] in [[District 1327|Breaktown]]. After they left, Mona Gale alerted the Lady about the meeting. Shortly thereafter she was approached and killed by the Heralds of [[Zildrog]]. Her murder irritated the Lady of Sorrows, who proceeded to kill the leader of the Heralds for his interference.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mona Gale appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 7: The Lady of Sorrows'''.
